playable_promise: Enter a real forensic detective case at Watson's side: hear a terrified woman's testimony, feel a violent stepfather's menace, and inspect a sealed murder-room where honest inspection of shutters, dummy bell-rope, ventilator, and Roylott's chamber lets you discover the hidden shape of a crime before night falls.

session_budget_decision.budget_reasoning: The Story Session Map fixes 25 minutes and an 11-15 moment range. I choose 12 moments: enough to let the guidance's must-breathe beats (Julia's death account, bruise reveal, shutters, dummy rope, Roylott's room, and the pre-vigil deduction) each own a room, while compressing front-loaded family history and travel logistics into fewer, denser moments. Twelve keeps the session brisk per the diagnosis's instruction to 'move briskly through testimony and travel while lingering on the room investigation' without inflating count past what a 25-minute play can inhabit. The forensic inspection cluster (105-107) gets three dedicated rooms; the confrontation (99-100) gets one charged room; testimony is split so Julia's death (94) breathes apart from compressed family history (93).

event_role_map.why: Entry Point: embodied waking with Holmes over the bed, the improper hour, and a live threshold choice of how Watson enters the case. Load-bearing identity posture (compassion/discipline/preparedness) that colors Helen's first trust.

First proof of the promise: the veiled woman, the fear-not-cold reveal, and Holmes's mud-and-ticket deduction give an inhabitable room where the player can question and observe deduction firsthand. Compressed per guidance but kept playable.

Extended family-history testimony; must-compress. Kept as a probe-driven room so backstory arrives as choosable questions (intuition vs procedure) rather than a monologue dump, preserving Roylott's menace and motive seeds.

Must-breathe: Julia's death account is the session's dread engine, with the whistle, the metallic clang, and 'the speckled band' dying words. Deserves a full inhabited room the player explores through questioning.

Must-compress but forensically load-bearing: the sealed-room facts (barred shutters, solid walls, staple-barred chimney, no poison) and the 'deep waters' dissatisfaction establish the locked-room puzzle. Folded with 94's questioning as active inquest probing.
Short strong beat: Helen now sleeps in the death chamber and heard the whistle last night. One image of renewed peril that spikes urgency; folded into the testimony-close room.
Must-breathe: the bruise reveal (protection vs exposure) is a load-bearing moral/relational pressure toward Helen and sets the same-day trip. Anchors the testimony-close room.
Must-compress: Holmes/Watson theory exchange ending on Roylott's interruption. Compressed to a short reactive beat that hands off to the burst-in door.

Roylott bursts in, trades bland-civility barbs, and bends the poker. Strong embodied menace room where the player can react with defiance, restraint, or protection while the threat is physical and present.
Holmes straightens the poker: a single answering image of quiet strength that caps the confrontation. Folded into the confrontation room as its release beat.
The will/income motive resolves the 'why' of the crime (evidence vs speed) and arms Watson with the revolver. Load-bearing motive clarity and the pistol setup for Session 2.
Must-compress: the Surrey journey and first sight of the mansion are connective cinematic movement with tonal spring-vs-sinister contrast but little agency. Compressed into travel montage.
event_role_map.reintroduction_note: Preserve the spring-vs-sinister-quest contrast and the first grey-gabled sighting of Stoke Moran as ambient traversal detail entering the arrival room; the driver's cover-story line surfaces there.

event_role_map.why: Must-compress: arrival via stile, handshake, and Roylott-away confirmation is logistical bridge. Compressed with the journey into the arrival montage that lands on the estate.
event_role_map.reintroduction_note: Keep the architect cover story and Helen's confirmation that Roylott is in town/away till evening as the arrival beat that greenlights the inspection window.

event_role_map.why: Holmes's decision to inspect at once plus the lock-yourself-in warning (stealth vs confrontation) sets the operational risk of Roylott noticing. Anchors the arrival-and-plan room with real agency.

Must-breathe: the exterior/shutter inspection is prime forensic play. The player examines wings, scaffolding, corridor windows, and tests barred shutters, discovering the locked-room barrier firsthand.

Must-breathe: the death-chamber interior with the dummy bell-rope and ventilator-into-adjoining-room is the session's central clue discovery. A richly inspectable room the player inhabits for several turns.
Must-breathe: Roylott's chamber with the iron safe, saucer of milk, bolted chair, and tied whipcord lash completes the apparatus discovery. Load-bearing forensic exploration.
Holmes's grave 'your life may depend on your compliance' warning is a short strong pressure beat that binds Helen to the plan; folded into the plan room.
Must-breathe: the signal-and-vigil plan (headache pretence, lamp signal, withdraw to old room) is collaborative operational staging the player shapes. Anchors the final room.
Watching Roylott drive past and the sitting-room light spring up is a short atmospheric consequence beat confirming the trap is set; folded into the plan/vigil-setup room.

Must-breathe: the pre-vigil deduction chain (ventilator inferred from cigar smell, clamped bed, dummy rope purpose) and courage-vs-caution commitment to the night. Final cash-out where clues assemble into dread.

moment_drafts.treatment: Final cash-out. From the Crown Inn they watch Roylott drive past and a light spring up. In gathering darkness Holmes assembles the clues — ventilator inferred from the cigar smell, the clamped bed, the dummy rope — and Watson commits to the dangerous vigil.
